"""Freeze V165 objective/unit audits,reductions and actual-viewing recorder before quality."""
import ast
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V165-pair-common-v1'
assert not (root/'train-result-v1.json').exists() and not (root/'scores-v1.json').exists()
scope=('All four fixed V165 endpoints. Identical47-tensor/124909-parameter V164 heads/data/init/optimizer/base losses differ only in added pair-average absolute RGB error weight0/1 with16DN16 pseudo-Huber units. Both keep difference floor2/weight1 and flat anchor.25. Exact V164 control. Historical contrasts mix interventions. Related adaptive cohort,not independent scenes/significance. All cases and worst increases retained. Actual native viewing recorded only after original-detail inspection;both protected scenes/priors/windows/JPEGs,ISO100 qualitative refs,notGT. Eight retained native columns.')
def rename(s):
 return s.replace('V164-pair-unit-floor-v1','V165-pair-common-v1').replace('v164-pair-unit-floor','v165-pair-common').replace('phase-control','fine-control').replace('fine-pair','pair-common').replace('Phase ctrl raw','Fine ctrl raw').replace('Phase ctrl EMA','Fine ctrl EMA').replace('Pair floor2 raw','Pair common raw').replace('Pair floor2 EMA','Pair common EMA')
sources=[]
for old in ['summarize-v164-final-v1.py','build-v164-tables-v1.py','paired-v164-regions-v1.py','quiet-dc-v164-final-v1.py','record-v164-viewing-v1.py','route-v164-final-v1.py','compare-v164-retained-v1.py','review-v164-effects-v1.py']:
 s=rename((repo/'.cache'/old).read_text())
 if old.startswith(('paired','compare','record','review')):
  prefix="        'scope':" if old.startswith('record') else "    'scope':"
  a=s.index(prefix);b=s.index('\n',a);s=s[:a]+prefix+repr(scope)+'})'+s[b:]
 if old.startswith('compare'):
  needle="    'V163':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V163-harmonic-phase-v1','harmonic-phase'),";assert needle in s
  s=s.replace(needle,needle+"\n    'V164':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V164-pair-unit-floor-v1','fine-pair'),")
 p=repo/'.cache'/old.replace('v164','v165');assert not p.exists();ast.parse(s);p.write_text(s);sources.append(ref(p))
for name in ['audit-v165-training-units-v1.py','audit-v165-training-objective-v1.py']:
 p=repo/'.cache'/name;ast.parse(p.read_text());sources.append(ref(p))
assert len(sources)==10
receipt=root/'final-helper-preparation-v1.json';assert not receipt.exists()
save(receipt,{'status':'fixed-reductions-and-actual-objective-unit-audits-prepared-before-quality','sources':sources,
 'protocol_snapshot':ref(root/'protocol-document-v1.md'),'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
 'prefix_objective_ledger_preflight':{'actual_rows':40,'bit_exact_FP32_losses':80,'prefix':ref(root/'readiness-training-prefix-v1.jsonl')},
 'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
public=repo/'docs/results/v165-final-helper-preparation-v1.json';assert not public.exists()
save(public,{'status':'fixed-before-trained-quality','preparation':ref(receipt),
 'source_texts':[dict(v,text=Path(v['path']).read_text()) for v in sources],
 'preparer':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
 'expected_actual_objective_checks':2000,'expected_unit_records':1000,'expected_unit_fingerprints':2000,'inherited_mask_records':1000,
 'expected_current_paired_entries':3264,'expected_retained_versions':10,'expected_retained_paired_entries':35840,
 'expected_retained_mean_cells':2960,'expected_score_table_cells':205,'actual_native_viewing_required':True,'scope':scope})
print('Frozen10 final helpers,80 actual prefix loss-ledger preflight checks,10 retained versions;quality remains pending')
